description: Write comprehensive unit tests for all core logic systems using NUnit-style test classes. Tests should be pure C# that validate logic without Unity runtime.
steps: Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/GameCoreTests.cs - Test GameCore state transitions: Init->Preparation, Preparation->Combat, Combat->Settlement, Settlement->RewardSelection, RewardSelection->Preparation, CoreHealth->Defeat, AllWaves->Victory. Test illegal transitions are rejected.

Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/GridMapTests.cs - Test: LoadFromConfig sets correct dimensions and cell states, IsBuildable returns true for Empty and false for Blocked/Occupied/SpawnPoint/CorePoint, SetCellState updates correctly, GetSpawnPoints and GetCorePoint return config values, IsInBounds boundary checks.

Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/PathfindingTests.cs - Test: direct path on empty grid, path around obstacles, no valid path returns empty, path recalculation after obstacle added, path from multiple spawn points.

Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/BuildingSystemTests.cs - Test: successful placement on empty cell, rejection on blocked cell, rejection on occupied cell, rejection when path would be blocked, rejection when resources insufficient, Remove clears cell state.

Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/CombatSystemTests.cs - Test: building attacks enemy in range, building does not attack enemy out of range, Nearest targeting selects closest, LowestHealth targeting selects weakest, enemy dies when health reaches 0, cooldown prevents rapid fire.

Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/ResourceSystemTests.cs - Test: initial balance correct, Add increases balance, TrySpend decreases balance, TrySpend fails when insufficient, CanAfford reports correctly, events fired on changes.

Create Assets/Tests/EditMode/RewardSystemTests.cs - Test: DrawRewards returns 3 cards, no duplicates in single draw, weighted selection respects weights (statistical test with many draws), ApplyReward ResourceBonus adds resources.
acceptance_criteria: All test files compile as valid C# with NUnit attributes ([Test], [SetUp], etc.)
Tests cover normal paths and edge cases for each system
Tests use mock/stub patterns where systems depend on others (e.g., mock GridMapSystem for BuildingSystem tests)
Each test class has proper [SetUp] method initializing required systems
Tests would pass when run against the implemented logic (correct assertions)
verification: All test .cs files exist in Assets/Tests/EditMode/
Tests exercise actual logic code (not just asserting constants)
findings: No dotnet SDK available for compilation (same as FEAT-001/002/003). Used Python-based syntax validation: balanced braces/parens/brackets, NUnit attributes verified, API reference cross-checks against all source files passed. All 7 test files created with correct test counts: GameCoreTests(8), GridMapTests(12), PathfindingTests(7), BuildingSystemTests(11), CombatSystemTests(7), ResourceSystemTests(8), RewardSystemTests(6). Total: 59 unit tests covering all core logic systems. EventBus is a static class so tests use EventBus.Clear() not instance creation. ServiceLocator.Clear() used in SetUp/TearDown for isolation.
